**Steps used to test these changes**

1. Opened Files > Settings > About
2. Clicked on "Open Log Location"

5. Clicked on "Open Log Location"

issue_context.title: Feature: Close Settings Dialog when opening Debug Log file folder
issue_context.body:
### What feature or improvement do you think would benefit Files?

Files should close Settings Dialog when opening Debug Log file folder when it's the default app because it not visually obvious that the action was taken. Folder opens in the background and again this is not clear.

### Requirements

- This will provide a cleaner UI
- It will provide a better visual feedback

### Files Version

3.4

### Windows Version

W11 23H2

_No response_
